propose.normative_voice: A tenant-scoped request asks for text.generate over an ordered, nonempty list of text messages, with an optional public model alias, routing strategy, positive maximum output-token count and stream flag.
propose.formal_voice: Request = (request_id, tenant_id, task, messages, model?, strategy, max_output_tokens, stream).
propose.plain_language_voice: A caller submits a conversation and chooses automatic routing or one named model.
propose.domain_context_voice: Example: one user message, no model, balanced strategy, 256 output tokens, JSON response.
propose.boundary: Tenant and request IDs are server-assigned; request fields never select credentials or upstream URLs.
propose.drift_route: Refresh when scope, API semantics, provider constraints or source plan changes.

propose.normative_voice: A versioned public alias describes a task and its supported input, output and streaming limits; discovery includes only offerings allowed for the authenticated tenant.
propose.formal_voice: Offering = (alias, version, tasks, context_limit, output_limit, streaming).
propose.plain_language_voice: An offering tells a caller which model option it may request.
propose.domain_context_voice: fixture-chat-a and fixture-chat-b are local test aliases, not claims about real model availability.
propose.boundary: An alias is neither a provider address nor a quality or availability guarantee.
propose.drift_route: Refresh when scope, API semantics, provider constraints or source plan changes.

propose.normative_voice: A versioned operator-owned binding connects an offering to one fixed provider deployment, mapper pair, credential reference, enabled state and execution limits.
propose.formal_voice: Binding = (id, version, offering, deployment_ref, credential_ref, mappers, enabled, limits).
propose.plain_language_voice: A binding describes how the service reaches an eligible provider.
propose.domain_context_voice: fixture-provider-a and fixture-provider-b are independent local bindings, both supporting text.generate and streaming.
propose.boundary: Configuration is private; fixture bindings grant no external-call or spending authority.
propose.drift_route: Refresh when scope, API semantics, provider constraints or source plan changes.

propose.normative_voice: A decision pins eligible bindings and the versioned policy. Automatic routing chooses the lowest configured strategy rank, breaking ties by stable binding ID. Explicit model selection restricts eligibility to that alias and never substitutes another alias.
propose.formal_voice: eligible = enabled AND tenant_allowed AND task_supported AND limits_fit AND features_supported; selected = min(eligible, (strategy_rank, binding_id)).
propose.plain_language_voice: First exclude unsuitable providers; then choose predictably among the remaining ones.
propose.domain_context_voice: balanced-v1 ranks fixture-provider-a before fixture-provider-b; disabling a selects b. No eligible binding yields 503.
propose.boundary: Configured cost/latency ranks are operator preferences, not measured price, speed or quality evidence.
propose.drift_route: Refresh when scope, API semantics, provider constraints or source plan changes.

propose.normative_voice: An attempt executes a pinned binding within one request deadline and concurrency budget. Automatic routing allows at most one fallback, only after a binding-specific outcome proves no execution occurred and before stream output starts.
propose.formal_voice: attempts <= 2; fallback => automatic AND proven_not_executed AND NOT stream_started AND deadline_remaining.
propose.plain_language_voice: An uncertain timeout must not cause a second generation or charge.
propose.domain_context_voice: A fixture pre-execution rejection may try b after a; ambiguous timeout or a partial stream may not.
propose.boundary: Disconnect triggers local cancellation and an upstream cancellation attempt, not proof that remote work or charges stopped.
propose.drift_route: Refresh when scope, API semantics, provider constraints or source plan changes.

propose.normative_voice: A completed result names the request, selected public alias, text output, finish reason and usage. Streaming sends started, zero or more delta events, then one completed or error event while writable; started pins the alias for that stream.
propose.formal_voice: Result = (request_id, model, output.text, finish_reason, usage); Stream = started, delta*, (completed | error).
propose.plain_language_voice: A caller receives one attributable answer or an explicit failure.
propose.domain_context_voice: A partial stream followed by failure ends with error and is never spliced with a different provider.
propose.boundary: Connection loss before a terminal event means incomplete output; fixture text is not evidence of model inference.
propose.drift_route: Refresh when scope, API semantics, provider constraints or source plan changes.

propose.normative_voice: Each attempt records input and output token counts as nonnegative integers or null, with provider-reported, locally-estimated or unavailable provenance for each count. Unknown values stay null; estimates name their estimator version.
propose.formal_voice: UsageCount = (value: integer>=0 | null, provenance, estimator_version?); Usage = (attempt_id, input_tokens, output_tokens).
propose.plain_language_voice: Usage says what was measured, estimated or remains unknown.
propose.domain_context_voice: A provider omitting token counts yields null with unavailable provenance, never zero.
propose.boundary: Usage is neither billing nor payment verification; failed-attempt observations remain distinct from final-result usage.
propose.drift_route: Refresh when scope, API semantics, provider constraints or source plan changes.

propose.normative_voice: An optional tenant-scoped key binds to the normalized validated request, its defaults and pinned request record. Matching in-flight duplicates receive a defined in-progress response; different normalized bytes return 409. Completed JSON can replay within retention; streams never re-execute under the same retained key.
propose.formal_voice: Identity = (tenant_id, key); same_identity AND different_request => 409; executions_per_retained_identity <= 1 logical request.
propose.plain_language_voice: Repeating a retained key must not start another inference request.
propose.domain_context_voice: Two concurrent JSON submissions with the same tenant, key and normalized request share the original request ID; the duplicate gets 409 request_in_progress until completion.
propose.boundary: Retention expiry ends deduplication protection; stream resumption and durable cross-restart protection remain open.
propose.drift_route: Refresh when scope, API semantics, provider constraints or source plan changes.

messages.constraints: nonempty array, at least one user message; no tools or multimodal parts

api_scope.model_selection: Omitted model selects automatically; provided nonempty alias selects explicitly. Null is invalid for optional fields.
api_scope.parameters: Only max_output_tokens is supported in this slice; positive integer excluding booleans, bounded by offering and tenant limits.

endpoints.meaning: Automatic or explicit text generation as JSON or SSE.
Unauthenticated liveness only; no model/provider diagnostics.

api_scope.authentication: Bearer key resolves tenant server-side for /v1/*; healthz has no secrets or readiness claim.
api_scope.error_shape: error {code, message, request_id}; no raw provider payloads or secrets.
api_scope.normalization: Validate first; materialize documented defaults; canonicalize object key order; preserve message order and text bytes; include all semantic fields. Keep policy/binding versions on the original record so replay does not reroute.
api_scope.discovery_security: Unknown and tenant-hidden aliases both return 404; 403 applies to a visible alias/task with an operation restriction.
api_scope.stream_contract: started contains request_id and model; delta contains request_id, model and text; completed contains request_id, model, finish_reason and usage; error contains request_id and sanitized error. completed does not repeat text. No resumption.
api_scope.fixture_limit_boundary: Proposed local acceptance-test inputs only. Input context fitting requires a binding-specific estimator; unknown fit excludes the binding. No real tokenizer or production limit is selected.
